steps: Grind the oats to a fine flour in a mixer.
Mash the banana in a bowl until very smooth.
Mix in the egg, oat flour, milk and cinnamon to make a thick batter.
Heat a flat pan on medium heat and rub it with a little of the butter.
Drop in spoonfuls of batter to make small pancakes.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until the edges are firm and the bottom is golden, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Cut into strips and cool until just warm before serving.
note: Oat flour instead of maida, and no sugar: a spotty, ripe banana sweetens them. Makes about five small pancakes.
